lead.event: BEI excludes high-concentration stocks from IHSG calculation
lead.headline: BEI excludes 81 HSC stocks accounting for 18.41% of JCI weight
lead.blurb: The temporary measure took effect on 2 November and runs through 29 January 2027. Affected stocks remain listed and tradable, but their price moves no longer affect the JCI. Their weights were redistributed among remaining constituents, with BBCA and BBRI each reaching 9.00%.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: The excluded stocks had about 18.41% of the JCI’s weight.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRIS addresses its free-float shortfall and planned rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BRIS plans rights issue as free float stands at 9.33%
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bank Syariah Indonesia is discussing an issue of up to 6.8 billion Series B shares at a nominal Rp500 each with stakeholders to meet the IDX’s 15% minimum. IDX says the threshold could be met if its three controlling shareholders do not exercise or transfer their pre-emptive rights, but no commitment has been received. The exercise price and timeline remain under discussion.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MBMA seeks approval for a private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA seeks approval for private placement of up to 10.79 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials will put the proposal to shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting on 8 December. The new shares would have a Rp100 nominal value each and could increase paid-in capital by up to 10%, with the company aiming to strengthen its capital structure.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Rukun Raharja reports nine-month profit and raises funds through bonds and sukuk
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: RAJA reports 9M profit up 82% and targets Rp1.55 trillion from bonds and sukuk
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Rukun Raharja is offering Rp1.01 trillion in bonds and Rp191.6 billion in sukuk, with proceeds for accelerated bank-loan repayment and working capital. The bonds carry 8.50% and 9.00% coupons for three and five years, respectively. The offering runs through 4 November, with listing planned for 11 November.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Champion Pacific prepares a share buyback for a proposed delisting
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: IGAR prepares Rp163.44 billion buyback for proposed delisting
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Champion Pacific plans to repurchase 155.66 million shares, or 16.78% of its issued and paid-up shares, at Rp1,050 each using internal cash. Shareholders will vote on the plan at an extraordinary meeting on 9 December, after which the company plans to delist from the Indonesia Stock Exchange.

earnings_guidance.blurb: GoTo posted net profit of Rp441 billion, reversing a Rp255 billion loss a year earlier and extending its profit trend to three consecutive quarters. Management estimated the 8% GoRide commission cap reduced the service’s profitability by Rp150 billion in the quarter.
